name: A_construction
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. One landscape 16:9 game environment concept, not a collage or poster. Reference 1: Sobaya identity only. Reference 2: canonical beer can only. High-quality achievable real-time 3D mobile game art. A SINGLE narrow straight steel I-beam connects two rooftop supports high above a city, spans left-to-right with a slight depth diagonal, complete beam and both ends visible. No floor beside the beam and no branching paths. Slightly elevated third-person gameplay camera. Full-body Sobaya near center, 18% of image height, feet walking on the beam: stocky muscular man, neutral grey skin, short black hair, EXACT white mask with red markings and black eyeholes matching reference, fitted white T-shirt, black trousers, white sneakers. Mask stays on. Shirt has natural pectoral volume and fabric folds but NO nipple bumps, outlines or pinpoint shading. Empty hands for walking. Three falling silver beer cans at different heights and orientations above the beam, reference label on front, plain silver reverse; recognizable gameplay objects, not advertising closeups. Two subtle landing markers on beam. PBR materials, designed architectural silhouettes, cinematic lighting, active play area sharp and readable against quieter atmospheric background. Calm corners for future HUD but NO actual HUD, text titles, callouts, labels, buttons or device frame. Lighthearted steel-beam challenge, no falling people, no horror, no crowds. Focus on environment design. Direction A: clear late-afternoon high-rise construction site. Ochre steel with bolts, exposed I-section, welds, fine yellow edges, concrete piers and hazard-striped end bumpers. Unfinished towers and distant cranes outside falling-can area. Slate-blue rooftops far below. Warm foreground against cool hazy city. Grounded tactile premium stylized realism.
